patternIssue.invalid: The namespace pattern {{pattern}} is not a regular expression Sextant can run, so the namespaces it names cannot be told.
patternIssue.notEvaluated: The namespace pattern {{pattern}} is too long or compiles too large, so Sextant does not run it and the namespaces it names cannot be told.

explain.valuesNotCompared: Values are never read or compared: the state comes from Reflector's annotations and the source's resourceVersion.
explain.inSync: Reflector copied the source's current version into this {{kind}}.
explain.stale: The source changed since Reflector last copied it: this mirror holds version {{reflected}}, the source is at {{current}}. Reflector usually catches up within seconds; if it does not, check that Reflector is running.
explain.staleNever: Reflector has not copied the source into this {{kind}} yet. If it stays so, check that Reflector is running and that the source allows this namespace.
explain.sourceMissing: The source {{source}} does not exist. Reflector leaves a manual mirror as it is and deletes an automatic one.
explain.notAllowed: The source no longer allows mirrors in namespace {{namespace}}: Reflector stops updating this mirror.
explain.notAllowedAuto: The source no longer creates automatic mirrors in namespace {{namespace}}: Reflector deletes this mirror.
explain.unknown: The source's namespace could not be read, so the state of this mirror cannot be told.
explain.permittedUnknown: Whether the source still allows namespace {{namespace}} cannot be told: a namespace pattern cannot be run here, or the namespace's labels are not known.
explain.invalidReflects: The reflects annotation is not namespace/name, so Reflector ignores this object.
explain.autoNeedsAllowed: Automatic mirrors are enabled but have no effect: reflection is not allowed from this object.
explain.selectorInvalid: Reflector cannot parse the selector {{selector}} and matches no namespace by it.
explain.targetsUnknown_one: Whether the source may be mirrored to {{count}} namespace cannot be told: {{namespaces}}.
explain.targetsUnknown_other: Whether the source may be mirrored to {{count}} namespaces cannot be told: {{namespaces}}.
explain.noMirrors: No mirror of it was found in the namespaces checked.
explain.conflict: Where the name is taken by another object, Reflector does not create the automatic mirror.
explain.notChecked_one: {{count}} namespace it may be mirrored to was not checked: {{namespaces}}.
explain.notChecked_other: {{count}} namespaces it may be mirrored to were not checked: {{namespaces}}.
